name: Orc Mob
source: The New Mordheimer, https://mordheimer.net/docs/warbands/grade-1a-warbands/orc-mob (fetched 2026-07-06). Grade 1a warband, author Mark Havener. Cited source: Town Cryer #6, revised in the Mordheim Annual 2002. Owner should cross-check against their own copy of that supplement/annual.

heroSlots.notes: 80 gc. Leader: any warrior within 6" may use his Leadership for Leadership tests. statMaximums null: Orcs are not Human — fill from the Orc Maximum Profile table if/when sourced.

40 gc, 0-1. May be armed with weapons from the Orc Equipment list, but never armour. Wizard: uses Waaagh! Magic (see Magic). statMaximums null: fill from the Orc Maximum Profile table if/when sourced.

40 gc, 0-2. The Boss's enforcers — if the Boss falls, the Big 'Uns decide on a new leader (usually through personal combat). statMaximums null: fill from the Orc Maximum Profile table if/when sourced.

henchmenTypes.notes: 25 gc, any number. Animosity: subject to the Animosity rules (see the warband's special rules / Leadership & Psychology). statMaximums null: fill from the Orc Maximum Profile table if/when sourced.

15 gc, any number — but never more than two Goblins for each Orc in the warband (counting Orc Heroes); the app doesn't enforce this ratio, so check it when recruiting. Animosity: subject to Animosity, but on a result of 1 will never charge an Orc Henchman (still shoots as normal). Not Orcs: each Goblin taken out of action counts as only half a model when checking whether the warband must take a Rout test. Runts: if the group rolls "The lad's got talent", the would-be Hero is immediately killed by his Orc overlords — remove one model instead of promoting. statMaximums null: fill from the Goblin Maximum Profile table if/when sourced.

15 gc, 0-5 — and never more Cave Squigs than Goblin Warriors in the warband (not enforced by the app; check when recruiting). No weapons or armour, ever — big gob and brutality. Movement: M is null because Squigs have no fixed Move — they bounce 2D6" each Movement phase, never run, never declare charges (contacting an enemy with the 2D6" move counts as charging for the following combat round). Minderz: each Squig must stay within 6" of a Goblin Warrior — if not at the start of its Movement phase it goes wild, moving 2D6" in a random direction each phase (fighting anything it contacts, friend or foe) for the rest of the game. Not Orcs: counts as half a model for Rout-test thresholds. Animals: never gains Experience.

200 gc, 0-1. May never be given weapons or armour (often carries a big club anyway). Fear: causes fear. Stupidity. Regeneration: whenever it suffers a wound, roll a D6 — on 4+ the wound is ignored; doesn't work against fire or fire-based magic; never rolls for Injury after a battle. Dumb Monster: too stupid to learn — never gains Experience. Always Hungry: 15 gc upkeep after every game, or sacrifice two Goblin Warriors/Cave Squigs to feed it instead; unpaid, the Troll wanders off (remove it). Vomit Attack: instead of its normal attacks, a single automatic hit at Strength 5 that ignores armour saves. Large Target as defined in the shooting rules.

specialRules: Orcs enjoy fighting and looting more than anything else, and Mordheim offers an aspiring Warboss endless supplies of both — ideally taken off other warbands rather than dug up. Distasteful Company: many Hired Swords refuse to work for Orcs — an Orc Mob may only hire Pit Fighters, Ogre Bodyguards, or Warlocks. Animosity: at the start of the Orc player's turn, roll a D6 for each Orc or Goblin Henchman not in hand-to-hand combat — on a 1 the warrior takes offence; roll again: 1 = "I 'Erd Dat!" (charges/shoots the nearest friendly Orc or Goblin Henchman as per the full Animosity rules), 2-5 = "Wud Yoo Say?" (spends the turn hurling insults, does nothing else), 6 = "I'll Show Yer!" (must move at full speed toward the nearest enemy, in addition to its normal move). See the full Animosity entry in the Rules Reference (Leadership & Psychology). Note the source's Goblin list prices Mad Cap Mushrooms at 25 gc at recruitment (the general rare-trade price is 30 + 3D6 gc).
